[Atlanta] A love letter to Manuel’s Tavern —

Manuel's Tavern is a political watering hole, attracting politicians such as Jimmy Carter, Bill Clinton, and Barack Obama. During big political events, Manuel’s is one of the hottest spots in town. Customers fill tables inside and out to wait for election results and cheer or jeer at debates. There’s no music playing, ever—just a couple of muted TVs.

[Atlanta] Disconnect from the world and reconnect with your better half at Little Palm Island —

A trip to Little Palm Island feels like a step toward intimacy—the very opposite of isolation. It’s a place to look the person we love in the eyes, talk to each other, and give each other the best gift any of us has: time. As we live our lives in this hectic world, going somewhere remote as a couple isn’t a mere luxury; it’s a way to protect what binds us.
